Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-rays demonstrate a marked shift of the cardiac silhouette into the right hemithorax with an abnormal contour and mediastinal displacement, which is characteristic of right-sided cardiac herniation through a pericardial defect following pneumonectomy or extensive pleural surgery. This mechanical complication explains the acute haemodynamic compromise due to torsion and obstruction of the great vessels.
